You take out your phone, scan that QR code, and a very satisfying, pleasing sound tells you it's done: ₹40 for chai, another ₹30 for samosas, a ₹200 lunch, an auto ride, a subscription, all paid in an instant! No worrying about carrying cash, no struggling to get change for that ₹500 note.
And while UPI has definitely made payments so much easier for us, there are some traps we all tend to fall into without even realising it. In this video, I'll reveal the 7 traps of the UPI payment system and I'll also help you avoid them.
Once you've watched the full video, I want you to do two things.
